title: Concept: absent Referrer-Policy
description: Without Referrer-Policy the browser default decides how much of the current URL travels in the Referer header to other origins, and paths often carry identifiers or tokens. A policy is the only way to pin that decision per site.
applicability: HTML responses and any response that may navigate or load cross-origin resources.
risk: Leakage of URL paths and query values to third parties; LOW severity.
